config_entries.description: List of config entries to write to gfxboot.cfg; each entry has section, option, and value fields. Sections are optional but will default to 'base' if omitted in entry.section. Format matches gfxboot's --change-config syntax (e.g., [Section]::Option=Value).

default_language.description: Default language locale (e.g., 'en_US', 'de_DE'). Corresponds to gfxboot's --default-language option.

languages.description: List of additional language locales to include. Corresponds to gfxboot's --add-languages option.

bootloader.description: Bootloader to use for preview/test (grub, lilo, isolinux, syslinux, pxelinux). Corresponds to gfxboot's --bootloader option.

theme.description: Active theme name (stored under /etc/bootsplash/themes/THEME/bootloader). Corresponds to gfxboot's --new-theme and --update-theme options.

preview_password.description: Password to embed in test config for preview. Corresponds to gfxboot's --password option.

preview_vm.description: Virtual machine to use for preview (bochs, qemu, qemu32, qemu64, vbox, vbox64, vmplayer, vmware). Corresponds to gfxboot's --vm option.

preview_arch.description: Architecture for preview image (32, 64, biarch). Corresponds to gfxboot's --32/--64/--biarch options.

preview_image_type.description: Image type for preview (cdrom, dvd, disk, floppy, net). Corresponds to gfxboot's --cdrom/--dvd/--disk/--floppy/--net options.
